segments.title: Stock on the catalogue page and in the cart store
context: A shopper could put any product in the cart, once per click, whether or not the shop had it. A product the shop has none of now shows a disabled button that reads "Out of stock". A click on "Add to cart" adds nothing when the cart already holds as many of the product as the shop has. The catalogue page also says how many of its products are in stock. The app requests the products again every 60 seconds while the catalogue is open.
## Overview
- **When** a shopper opens a catalogue of 5 products of which 3 are in stock, **then** [a line above the products reads "3 of 5 products in stock"](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L11-13).
- **When** a product has a stock of 0, **then** [its button reads "Out of stock" and is disabled](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7).

- **When** a shopper clicks "Add to cart" on a product with a stock of 2 that is in the cart twice, **then** [the cart stays as it is](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L16), and the button still reads "Add to cart".
- **When** a shopper clicks "Add to cart" on a product with a stock of 2 that is in the cart once, **then** nothing changes: the cart gets one more item.
- **When** the catalogue stays open, **then** [the app requests the products again every 60 seconds](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#L9).
- **When** the app requests the products, **then** [the request goes to `/api/products?include=stock`](code:src/api/products.ts#L5), where it went to `/api/products` before.
- **When** a shopper opens the cart page, **then** nothing changes.

- Modified [`addItem`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L13-19) to [count the items of the cart that have the id of the product](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L15).

waypoints.title: Modified `addItem` to add no more of a product than its stock
waypoints.reading:
The author modified a method `addItem` of the store `useCartStore` that now:

- counts the items of `state.items` whose `product.id` is the id of the product, into `quantityInCart`
- returns the same `state` when `quantityInCart >= product.stock`
- appends `{ product, quantity: 1 }` otherwise, as it did on every call

[The "Add to cart" button of `<AddToCartButton />` calls `addItem(product)`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L8), and [that component returns a disabled button only when `product.stock === 0`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7), so that this condition is the one that keeps a product with a stock of 2 at two items in the cart. `addItem` reads [the `stock` that `Product` now declares](code:src/types/product.ts#L6). `<CartBadge />` in `src/components/CartBadge.tsx` and the three components under `src/routes/cart/` read `items`, `removeItem`, `clear` and the two selectors, and none of them calls `addItem`.
waypoints.needsAttention: This is the rule the pull request exists for: `addItem` adds no item when the cart holds `product.stock` items of the product. [`<AddToCartButton />` has a condition for a stock of `0` only](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7), and every other stock reaches this one.

waypoints.title: Added `stock` to the interface `Product`
waypoints.reading: The author added a field `stock: number` to the interface `Product`. [`<CatalogPage />` counts the products whose `stock` is over `0`](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L8), [`<AddToCartButton />` compares `stock` with `0`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7) and [`addItem` compares `stock` with the quantity in the cart](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L16), so that all three need the field on every product. [`fetchProducts()` requests `"/products?include=stock"`](code:src/api/products.ts#L5), and [`request()` returns the JSON of the response as `Product[]` with a cast](code:src/api/client.ts#L24). No code in the repository builds a `Product` itself.

journeyNodes.label: Reads the products from the products query
journeyNodes.description: When a shopper opens the catalogue, `router` in `src/router.tsx` renders `<CatalogPage />` at the index route `/`. The page is a change of the shared segment, and on this path it is the caller of [`useProducts()`](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#useProducts).

journeyNodes.label: Runs the products query every 60 seconds
journeyNodes.description: When a shopper opens the catalogue, [`<CatalogPage />` calls this hook](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L5) on every render.

blockLabels.label: Sets the refetch interval to 60 seconds

journeyNodes.label: Requests the products with their stock
journeyNodes.description: When a shopper opens the catalogue, [`<CatalogPage />` calls `useProducts()`](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L5), and [`useProducts()` hands this function to `useQuery` as `queryFn`](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#L9). `useQuery` calls it, and no code of the repository calls it by name.

waypoints.title: Modified `fetchProducts()` to request the products with `include=stock`
waypoints.reading: The author modified a function `fetchProducts()` that now requests `"/products?include=stock"`, where it requested `"/products"`. [`request()` puts `/api` before the path](code:src/api/client.ts#L19), so the request goes to `/api/products?include=stock`. [`Product` now declares `stock: number`](code:src/types/product.ts#L6), and this request is the one place the app gets its products from, so that [`<CatalogPage />`](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L8), [`<AddToCartButton />`](code:src/routes/catalog/components/AddToCartButton.tsx#L7) and [`addItem`](code:src/stores/cart-store.ts#L16) read the `stock` this request returns. [`useProducts()` passes this function to `useQuery` as `queryFn`](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#L9), and no other file uses it.

waypoints.title: Added the constant `STOCK_REFRESH_MS`
waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `STOCK_REFRESH_MS` that has the value `60_000`. [`useProducts()` passes it to `useQuery` as `refetchInterval`](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#L9), so that the query requests the products again every 60 seconds. The constant has no `export`, and nothing else reads it.

waypoints.title: Modified `useProducts()` to refetch the products on an interval
waypoints.reading: The author modified a function `useProducts()` that now passes `refetchInterval: STOCK_REFRESH_MS` to `useQuery`, where it passed no interval. [`STOCK_REFRESH_MS` is `60_000`](code:src/hooks/use-products.ts#L6), so `useQuery` calls [`fetchProducts()`](code:src/api/products.ts#fetchProducts) again every 60 seconds. [`<CatalogPage />` is the one caller](code:src/routes/catalog/index.tsx#L5), so that the `stock` the page counts and passes to its cards changes while the page stays open. `queryClient` in `src/lib/query-client.ts` sets `staleTime` to `30_000` and `retry` to `false` for every query, and this change leaves both as they are.
